heading: RBI Repo Rate Hike: Impact on Your Home Loan EMI
tldr: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has increased the repo rate by 25 basis points (bps) to 5.50% on October 7, 2026.
This hike will directly affect your home loan interest rates, especially if your loan is linked to an external benchmark.
Borrowers may see an increase in their monthly Equated Monthly Instalment (EMI) or an extension of their loan repayment tenure.
Understanding your loan's benchmark and current interest rate is crucial to assess the immediate impact.
Proactive steps like partial prepayments or switching lenders can help mitigate the financial burden.
caption:
Heads up, home loan holders! The RBI just made a small change to the repo rate, and it might mean your monthly EMI could go up a bit, or your loan might take longer to pay off. If you have a home loan, this update is important for your wallet. Our latest article explains what this means for you and what you can do about it. Read more here.
